summary_1line: Vidura advises Dhritarashtra on virtues of wise conduct, self‑restraint, and sense control, urging just rule and returning the Pandavas’ rightful share.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura calmly counsels the anxious, sleepless King Dhritarashtra in a dim royal chamber while attendants stand silent.
A charioteer drives a chariot whose horses symbolize the senses, either well‑reined and steady or wild and dragging the rider toward ruin.
Five radiant princes, the sons of Pandu, stand together in the forest like five Indras under tall trees.
